name: chunk_state
description: Per-chunk Mamba2 state accumulation with signature chunk_state(B, x, dt, dA_cumsum). B is [batch,seqlen,ngroups,dstate], x is [batch,seqlen,nheads,headdim], and dt/dA_cumsum are [batch,nheads,nchunks,chunk_size] with seqlen=nchunks*chunk_size and nheads divisible by ngroups. For each batch, chunk and head, map the head to group h//(nheads/ngroups) and compute states[b,c,h,p,n] = sum_t x[b,c,t,h,p] * B[b,c,t,g,n] * exp(dA_cumsum[b,h,c,last] - dA_cumsum[b,h,c,t]) * dt[b,h,c,t]. Return a newly allocated float32 [batch,nchunks,nheads,headdim,dstate] tensor. The native implementation accumulates in float32 and, for bf16/fp16 inputs, applies the scale in float32 before native-precision tensor-core products. Inputs are not modified. The suite exercises bfloat16 B/x and float32 dt/dA.
